verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail documents a network of 53 real street addresses and says the address can be listed on public records. It also says the address works with LegalZoom business formation services, which supports the LLC-registration use. The pack never says the address is accepted for bank KYC or vendor forms, and never explicitly says it is not a PO Box. missing for 10: evidence of acceptance for bank KYC, evidence of acceptance on vendor forms, explicit non-PO-Box/CMRA treatment, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I get a real street address (not a PO Box) that works for LLC registration, bank KYC, and vendor forms

citations.quote: Choose from 53 real street addresses across 44 states, including prime locations like Park Avenue in New York and Market Street in San Francisco.
Protect your privacy by listing a virtual business address on public records instead of exposing your own to the public.
Virtual Mail also works with your LegalZoom business formation services, including complimentary Secretary of State Status reports and other entitled services.
